notes: This is a place and a mood rather than a game type — a woodland, birds, and 'just a chill game' — and the author confirmed there is nothing to do but hang out, with no collectibles or goals, so No Genre is the honest answer instead of inventing a showcase or a roleplay town around it. Social Space is the preset that matches a hangout: the seating spots the author asked for become the gathering clearing, spawn-area puts arrival somewhere composed in the trees, and landmark-focal is bent to a single tall distinct tree so players can orient inside the woodland. The birds flying around are a request the author actually made and land on npc-population as ambient animals rather than anything hostile. All five axes stay at their defaults — an exterior, single-surface, single-zone, dressed, grounded woodland — which routes P0 with no modifier.
